notes.title: Cyberpunk DLC is out now!
notes.content:
The second DLC for Kubikon 3D is here, and it's packed with neon lights, lasers and brand new mechanics. Welcome to the future!

In the Cyberpunk DLC, you’ll dive into a glowing, high-tech world of flying cars and laser traps. Thirty new levels offer fresh challenges featuring city barriers, force fields and colour-changing lasers that test your skills. And of course, all the new mechanics are ready to use in the level editor, so you can craft your own neon puzzles and share them with the world.

Two more DLCs are on the way later this year, each bringing a new setting and gameplay twists. Stay tuned!

Think you’ve got what it takes to master the tech maze? Time to plug in. Kubikon 3D - Cyberpunk DLC is available now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650030/Kubikon_3D__Cyberpunk_DLC/
Thank you for your support. Enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Warehouse DLC is now available!
notes.content:
The first expansion for the puzzle game Kubikon 3D brings brand-new challenges and mechanics. Welcome to the warehouse!

In Warehouse DLC, you'll dive into a fresh batch of levels set in an industrial environment. It introduces fresh gameplay elements like gates, buttons, fences, and conveyor belts that completely change the way puzzles are solved. Whether you're a seasoned puzzler or just discovering the world of Kubikon, Warehouse DLC is the perfect place to jump in and get your gears turning.

Feeling creative? Now’s the perfect time to jump in! The level editor supports all the new elements from the Warehouse DLC. Start building your own tricky levels and challenge the community with your clever designs!

And the best part? Warehouse is just the beginning.
More DLCs are coming soon, each introducing new environments and unique gameplay twists. Stay tuned!

Kubikon 3D - Warehouse DLC is available now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642140/Kubikon_3D__Warehouse_DLC
Thank you for your support and enjoy the new levels!

notes.title: Unveiling the DLC Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to reveal the future roadmap for the game! Get ready for even more challenges, new mechanics, and exciting environments!

Here's what's coming:

[b]Warehouse DLC[/b] – releasing on May 22, 2025
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642140/Kubikon_3D__Warehouse_DLC/
Enter an outdoor warehouse filled with gates, fences, buttons, conveyor belts, and plenty of tricky puzzles!

[b]Cyberpunk DLC[/b] – coming later in 2025
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650030/Kubikon_3D__Cyberpunk_DLC/
Dive into a futuristic neon world with new tech obstacles and digital challenges!

[b]Pirates DLC[/b] – coming in autumn 2025
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3693980/Kubikon_3D__Pirates_DLC/
Sail across treacherous waters, discover mysterious islands, and unlock treasures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665950/Kubikon_3D__Arctic_DLC/

Each DLC will introduce new mechanics, tougher puzzles, and fresh environments to explore. They will also expand the level editor, giving you even more tools to create your own challenges — and share them on the Steam Workshop! There are already nearly 150 levels created by the community!

[b]Warehouse DLC launches very soon — don't miss it![/b]
Make sure to add the upcoming DLCs to your wishlist and stay tuned — the adventure is just beginning!

notes.title: Kubikon 3D is out now!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that Kubikon is now available on Steam. Step into the colorful world of cubes now!

[h3]Explore and Compete[/h3]
With dozens of levels, Kubikon challenges your skills and courage. In ranked mode, you can compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboard. For a more relaxed experience, casual mode offers endlessly replayable levels that rearrange themselves differently every time. You can play with a mouse, keyboard, or your favorite gamepad!

[previewyoutube=F_xqmn_8svA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F_xqmn_8svA[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Create and Share[/h3]
Unleash your creativity with our built-in level editor. Design your own puzzles and share them with friends or the global community through Steam Workshop. 

[h3]Join the Community[/h3]
Got feedback, questions, or just want to share your initial victories (or amusing defeats)? I'm all ears! Join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/avabBNY]Discord[/url]. Your insights make Kubikon 3D even better.

Thank you for your support! Dive into the world of Kubikon and start playing now!
Petr Kubicek aka KUBI Games

notes.title: Level Editor and Steam Workshop
notes.content:
Unleash your creativity with the built-in level editor that lets you create your own levels and share them with friends or even the world! With simple controls, anyone can create a unique level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767366/5a742c4cc7d8932ef938af820b592da271d452a7.png[/img]

The camera and cursor controls are the same as in the game. On the left side you'll see blocks to choose from. Don't be fooled by the fact that there are only white cubes. Since the levels can be randomly shuffled, the correct colors will be added in the game itself, based on the platforms you place.

Any errors you should correct are shown in the bottom right corner of the screen. You must test your level before anyone else can play it. Only then will it appear in the in-game list. 

[h3]Steam Workshop[/h3]
Kubikon 3D supports Steam Workshop. This gives you access to a virtually infinite number of levels. It's up to you and the community to decide how many to create and what they will be.

[h3]Try the demo![/h3]
If you haven't tried the demo yet, there's still time to do so. It gives you a taste of the first five levels. Compete against others and show that you're ready for release

[h3]Join the community[/h3]
Got any feedback or questions for me? I'm all ears! Join the community on Discord. You can make Kubikon 3D even better.

The release date is fast approaching and I'm really looking forward to seeing what levels you can create!

Stay cubed!
Petr Kubicek aka KUBI Games

notes.title: Release date and future content
notes.content:
Greetings to all cubers!

[h3]Release Date[/h3]
May 23rd 2024 will be the official release date of the game! After the successful demo, which you could try for the first time during the Steam Next Fest, I haven't slowed down and am working hard to bring you the full version with new challenges. If you haven't tried the demo yet, you still have a chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703100/Kubikon_3D/
[h3]Free Updates[/h3]
Right from launch, you'll have 50 varied levels at your fingertips, and some of them will really give you a hard time. But it doesn't stop there. I plan to spoil you with free updates that will add more levels to the game. Thanks to the built-in editor, you will be able to continuously expand the list yourself!

[h3]Additional content[/h3]
And hold on to your hats, because this is just the beginning! Your Kubikon 3D adventure will be enriched with several additional packs soon after release! These will be released over the course of this year and next. Each DLC will bring new environments and most importantly, new gameplay mechanics and puzzles that are guaranteed to challenge you.

[h3]Join the Community[/h3]
Got feedback, questions, or just want to share your initial victories (or amusing defeats)? I'm all ears! Join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/avabBNY]Discord[/url]. Your insights make Kubikon 3D even better.

Stay cubed until next time!
Petr Kubicek aka KUBI Games

notes.title: Demo coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm thrilled to announce that on February 5th, I'll be releasing a demo of my game, Kubikon 3D, as a part of Steam Next Fest. As the sole developer behind this project, it's been an incredible journey crafting this game, and I can't wait for you all to try it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767366/c30a6b07e3413f18764ef3c1792fd5affb693b7e.jpg[/img]
In the demo, you'll get a taste of the game with 5 unique levels. Kubikon 3D combines elements from classic puzzles like Tetris, Arkanoid, and Sokoban, but with its own unique spin. It's more than just a game of cubes; it's a challenge, a brain teaser, and a bit of nostalgic fun rolled into one.

I've been running a closed beta, and the input from players has been invaluable. Seeing how everyone tackles the puzzles and competes for high scores on the leaderboards has been fascinating. I'm really excited to see how you guys do in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767366/2edbe8055b2f9a5958faab221a46a690874ef227.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767366/be8e2d7008bf108dcd0ed637efbf13d573286912.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767366/e1e3d5b0e1c6e8b8b57c2ca9a2cb264e0f7aa3e1.jpg[/img]
For more information about Kubikon 3D, feel free to check the Steam store page. There you can find details about the gameplay, the levels, and the level editor that will allow you to create and share your own puzzles in the full game.

Hope to see you in Kubikon 3D!
Petr Kubicek aka KUBI Games
